name: amfx-btc-cme-futures-contrarian-research
description: amFX reproduction (29MAY24 p3 bottom): Bitcoin 2016-2018 showing CME bitcoin futures launch at the exact Dec 2017 peak (~$19,000) as a contrarian product launch indicator. The bullish product launched at the top, illustrating the same contrarian principle as the NOPE ETF at the SPX bottom. When a financial product is created to monetize a prevailing trend, it signals trend exhaustion.
source:
# =============================================================================
# AMFX REPRODUCTION: Bitcoin with CME Futures Launch (29MAY24 p3 bottom)
# =============================================================================
# CME launched bitcoin futures on Dec 17, 2017 — the exact peak of the
# 2017 crypto mania. BTC hit ~$19,000 and then crashed ~80% to ~$3,200.
# The bullish product at the top mirrors the bearish NOPE ETF at the bottom.
# =============================================================================

src = market_data_source()()
close = src.c
idx = index()

# Moving averages
ma50 = ma(period=50)(close)

xy_lines(
    title='Bitcoin 2016-2018: Did CME Futures Launch Mark the Top?',
    category='Product Launch Contrarian',
    y_axis_label='BTC Price (USD)',
    y_axis_format=CardRenderType.DecimalFormat,
    y_axis_dp=0,
    series=LineSeriesSchema(series=[
        LineSeriesSpec(name='BTC Close', color=Color.Blue),
        LineSeriesSpec(name='50d MA', color=Color.Sky, dash_style=DashStyle.Dot)
    ]),
    reference_lines=ReferenceLineSchema(lines=[
        ReferenceLine(value=19000.0, title='CME Launches Bitcoin Futures (Dec 2017)', color=Color.Red, dash_style=DashStyle.Dash)
    ]),
    order=0
)(x_values=idx, y_values=(close, ma50))
